title: Stream ingest rate limiter + 429 + Retry-After
description: Proves that the stream ingest endpoint enforces a per-ontology token-bucket rate limiter (default 1000 rps per ontology, configurable via WEAVE_INGEST_RATE_PER_SEC / WEAVE_INGEST_RATE_BURST). When the bucket is exhausted the handler returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED with a Retry-After header. Different ontologies maintain independent buckets so a runaway client on ontology A does not starve ontology B.

parameters.reason: ingest rate limit exceeded for this ontology

notes: Rate limiter is checked BEFORE policy evaluation and JSON parsing so a burst of 429s is cheap.
nil rate limiter (pre-US-063 or degraded mode) allows all requests — backwards compatible.
Wired in cmd/server/main.go via deps.IngestRateLimiter only when NATS/FunnelPublisher is available.
